basic_info.description: Discover timeless charm in one of San Francisco's most welcoming neighborhoods. Just half a block from Sunset Boulevard, this classic 1940s semi-detached single-family home offers both character and convenience. Step inside this Center Patio home and you'll find a vintage kitchen, and charming details that capture the warmth and craftsmanship of another era. First time on the market in over 70 years. The location is unbeatable: enjoy Golden Gate Park, Lake Merced, Lakeshore Plaza, Stonestown Galleria, or West Portal. The home offers plenty of opportunity for a new owner to make it their own. Whether you preserve its vintage character or create a modern update, this Parkside gem is ready for its next chapter.
